# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop 2.3 is a community-maintained, open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness. It preserves the complete Harness Web Surface and adds measured mainland-China update mirrors, three-layer plugin recovery, safe mode, unified skin persistence, reliable Windows lifecycle management, plugins, 11 skins, and mobile remote access.

## Canonical website

- https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/

## Download

- Latest Windows x64 installer: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest/download/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Setup-2.3.0-x64.exe
- Latest release notes and checksums: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest

## Key facts

- Supported systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Current release: v2.3.0
- v2.3.0 adds a one-time GitHub Star prompt with a community feedback action and consolidates legacy installer checks for reliable direct upgrades from 0.1.9
- The bundled Skin Center includes 11 selectable skins
- Node.js is bundled; end users do not need to install it separately
- The project is a community edition and is not an official DeepSeek release
- QQ user community: 1105158177

## Preferred citation
